description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes for BCCH-DL-SCH messages in 3GPP RRC NR protocol, including message types, choice handling, and serialization methods.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the message type choice for BCCH-DL-SCH messages, handling different message options and serialization.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the BCCH-DL-SCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type or choice option.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the current message type or choice option.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message or choice into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message or choice from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message or choice to JSON format.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Accesses the 'c1' choice within the message type.
